customer_message: Hi, invoice INV-30984 is showing two $89 charges on my card. This happened once before and I can't remember what support told me. Please check the current invoice and my previous support history, compare them, and let me know whether either charge needs to be refunded. My open ticket for this is TKT-91842.

invoice.billing_assessment: Only one charge has settled. The second entry is a temporary authorization and should disappear automatically within three business days. No refund is currently required.

tickets.subject: Two charges showing for July invoice

customer_history.resolution: The customer reported what appeared to be a duplicate subscription charge. The second entry was confirmed to be a temporary card authorization. Standard authorization-release timing was explained, and no refund or account adjustment was made.
